items.title: Will Shade and Dewey Corley Interview, 1960-05-25
items.q: They played with Jack Kelly. Will Betts. He played violin.

ctx.x: He played guitar. Doc Higgins. They had the South Memphis jug band. He blowed the jug. Great big fella. Called Doc Higgins. And let me see. Two or three other boys played guitar around here. But I just can't remember the name. They played with Jack Kelly. Will Betts. He played violin. And he's dead. Jack Kelly's dead.
You remember Slucks and his Memphis Ramblers?
